description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Changes a campaign's campaign-level budget to budgetMinor (whole cents, e.g. 4000 = $40), keeping its type: a daily budget is held to the owner's per-day agent ceiling, a lifetime budget to the per-campaign ceiling (read both with ads_caps_get). Scaling down is always inside the ceiling. Uses the same budget rules and activation spend caps as the dashboard; pass idempotencyKey to make a retry safe. Guardrails: flayr enforces the owner's agent ceiling (per month, per campaign, per day) on the server; you cannot raise it. Inside it the change is applied at once; above it nothing changes and the result is `approval_requested` (HTTP 202) with `approvalUrl`, the owner's one-click approval link: give it to the user, and repeat the exact same call once the owner approves (the approval covers that call once). Every call is audited (Ads > Agent activity) and the owner gets a daily digest. Pass agentName and reason; both are shown to the owner. Confirm the new amount with the user first.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/campaigns/{id}/budget.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

budgetMinor.description: The new budget, whole cents (e.g. 4000 = $40), daily or lifetime as the campaign is set up.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; a retry with the same key does not apply the change twice.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_campaign_scale
title: Scale a campaign budget
